facts.fact: Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo, Executive Director of the Data Protection Commission, gave the welcome address at the 2026 Data Protection Conference in Accra.
Minister Samuel Nartey George said the government is developing a new Data Protection Bill to strengthen enforcement, clarify international transfer rules and enhance citizens' rights.

GHA.note: The bill is said only to clarify transfer rules; no condition on sending data abroad is stated and no draft is published.
